summary: Successfully implemented KAFKA-20444 to align TxnOffsetCommit API with OffsetCommit API (KIP-1319). Added metadata freshness check in KafkaProducer.sendOffsetsToTransaction by creating a new awaitTopicsMetadata method that ensures all topics in the offset map are available in the metadata cache with their topic IDs. This enables the TransactionManager to negotiate TxnOffsetCommit v6+ (which uses topic IDs) instead of v5 (which uses topic names). Topics are naturally evicted from the metadata cache based on idle timeout. All existing tests pass including new tests for v6 negotiation scenarios.
